ABOUT US

Progress, people, and practical coverage have shaped Motive from day one.

Get Your Quote

PERSONAL LIVES. WORKING LIVES.

Coverage for real life and business.

A home, a vehicle, a business you have built. Each comes with different responsibilities, and each deserves a coverage conversation that starts with you.

Motive helps individuals and businesses understand insurance options for everyday life and the work ahead. From auto and homeowners coverage to trucking, commercial fleets, and business insurance, we help you ask the right questions before choosing a policy.

Explore personal insurance →
Explore business insurance →
Behind every move is a home, a livelihood, and something worth protecting.

HOW MOTIVE WORKS

A clear path to your next decision.

Insurance is easier to consider when you understand what you need, what your options mean, and where to turn with questions.

01
Understand

Start with your household or operation, your current coverage, and what is changing.

02
Compare

Review eligible options, including limits, deductibles, exclusions, and the differences that matter to you.

03
Protect

Choose appropriate coverage and confirm the policy details and effective dates before relying on it.

04
Support

Return with policy questions, document requests, or changes to your home, vehicles, or business.

Practical questions first. A more informed coverage decision next.

INDEPENDENT GUIDANCE

Why choose an independent insurance agency?

An independent agency can help you compare eligible insurance options and understand how they fit your circumstances. At Motive, that conversation connects the policy details to your daily life or business.

Look beyond the premium.

Compare what a policy covers, its limits, and where exclusions or deductibles could affect you.

Make the review practical.

Bring your current policy and any contract requirements so we can discuss the questions specific to your situation.

Connect personal and business needs.

Talk through changes at home and at work, from a new vehicle to another truck or a growing fleet.

Talk through your coverage →

PEOPLE BEHIND THE POLICIES

Your priorities shape the conversation.

Trust starts with clear explanations and room for your questions. Whether you are looking after your family, running a business, or working on the road, we help you consider coverage in the context of what you do.

For the people building a business and planning what comes next.
For the people whose work keeps goods and businesses moving. Explore trucking coverage.

YOUR NEXT CHAPTER

Coverage that moves with you.

A new home. A different vehicle. Another truck in the fleet. When your circumstances change, make space for a fresh look at your insurance.

Tell Motive what is next, and start a conversation about your personal or commercial coverage.

Get Your Quote →
